headline: Email spent $752 over 15 days with zero conversions, so I paused it. Direct's lift is untracked demand that looks AI-driven, and I left budgets alone.

moves.reason: Zero conversions for 15 days since 10/17 on $752 spend, with daily spend rising from $39 to $60. Prior 10 weeks averaged about 15 conversions/week. Newsletter self-reports also fell to 0% in the last two weeks, so sends or tracking appear broken. Cheap to reverse once fixed.

tests.hypothesis: LinkedIn's true ROAS is above the 1.5 target. Last-touch gives 1.14, while the other four models give 1.70 to 2.33.
tests.design: Run a geo holdout. Pause LinkedIn in about 20% of matched regions for 4 weeks and keep it running elsewhere. Measure total conversions and revenue across all channels, including direct and branded search, in held-out vs control regions. Keep the current budget until it reads out.

tests.hypothesis: Email's tracked conversions stopped on 10/17 because of a tracking or send failure, not because buyers stopped. Models credit it between 3.5% (last-touch) and 21% (first-touch).
tests.design: First, audit the send logs and UTM/conversion tracking from 10/17 onward. Once it is fixed, restart with a 10% random holdout of the list for 4 weeks. Compare conversions and revenue per recipient, tracked and untracked, between the held-out and emailed groups.

flag_verdicts.reason: Email has had 0 conversions since 10/17. It spent $752 over 15 days, and daily spend rose from $39 to $60. It averaged about 15 conversions a week before that. Newsletter self-reports fell to 0% in the last two weeks. Paused.

Direct rose from 3.1 to 6.9 conversions a day while paid spend moved 1.01x. 'Asked ChatGPT' answers rose from about 1% to 14-18%, and 'AI assistant' answers rose from 11% to 22% combined in the flag's window. That points to AI-driven discovery, not a paid channel, so I did not credit or move any paid budget. Keep monitoring.

flags.message: email spent $752 over 15 days with zero conversions, and spend is still rising.
Direct conversions grew 2.2x (3.1 to 6.9/day) while paid spend moved 1.01x. Self-reported AI answers went from 11% to 22%. Something untracked is driving buyers.

label: synthetic data
